Behind the scenes, American brokers are preparing to launch perpetual futures contracts in the US, anticipating a regulatory shift that could expand investor access to the market.

Perpetual futures are contracts that allow traders to bet on price direction without an expiration date. Currently restricted to offshore platforms, their arrival in the American market would represent a significant regulatory milestone for the sector.
